attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Dentistry

rules.accepted_credit_types: Educational/scientific courses sponsored or approved by accredited educational or service institutions, professional associations and societies, accredited postdoctoral programs, government health agencies, accredited hospitals; National Board/CDCA exams; ADA-recognized specialty board maintenance; self-study with test, teaching, faculty/research, publications and table clinics within caps
rules.new_licensee_rule: New graduates of CODA-accredited/Board-approved programs are exempt for the licensing period in which they graduate.
rules.audit_note: Signed statement under pains and penalties of perjury at renewal; sponsors keep attendance records 5 years.

topics.who: CDC Guidelines course each biennial renewal (hours not stated)
Dentists with a Massachusetts Controlled Substance Registration or DEA registration or who otherwise prescribe: training under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 18(e) (hours not stated in 234 CMR 8)
Continuous CPR/AED or BLS (ACLS/PALS for anesthesia permit holders)

rules.notes: 40 CEUs in the 24 months before March 31 of even-numbered years. Continuous CPR/AED or BLS certification (ACLS/PALS for anesthesia permit holders). Max 20 CEUs self-study with test; other category caps apply.
